messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — quick heads up, Legal asked for an emergency unredact / audit access flow for tenant `acme-corp` (eDiscovery). They want a way to flip on full request/response capture for 1 hour with reason + audit trail. How do we do this without blowing quotas or violating PII rules?

Kevin Patel: We already have an inspect-mode but it's tenant-global and leaves traces in logs. Can we make it per-tenant + TTL + reason tag? :thinking:

Jordan Lee: +1 on TTL + reason. Also need KMS annotation on any exported artifacts and an audit-event with who triggered it. We should avoid storing raw payloads unless flagged for retention policy.

Sara Gomez: Ops concern: if we enable full payloads, ingestion tokens could spike and hit rate limits for the tenant. Need a quota bump or throttled mirror pipeline to dedicated audit storage.

Alex Wright: Proposed flow:
• `audit-unmask` API that takes tenant_id, ttl_secs, reason, approver_id
• marks requests as `audit_allowed:true` in routing metadata
• routes a copy of payloads to an encrypted audit S3 bucket (kms_key_id)
• increments metric `audit_ingest_billed_tokens`
• console shows active sessions with `unmask_session_id`, expires_at, reason

Maria Chen: Example admin command:
```
/admin audit-unmask --tenant acme-corp --ttl 3600 --reason "legal:case-123" --approver @legal
```
ops-bot: Note: enabling audit-unmask will also enable unredact preview in console for users with `audit_viewer` role.

Kevin Patel: What about auto-sampling? We can avoid full capture for every request by allowing `capture_rate` param (0-1). For legal holds they want full capture though. Maybe default 1 but require legal attestation.

privacy-bot: Policy check: must record attestation + retention policy. If PII is present, we require HSM-wrapped export and record hash-only in regular telemetry. Also, redact sensitive fields in non-audit paths.

Jordan Lee: UX for console: add a lightweight canary toggle + hard confirm with typed reason and a checkbox "I confirm legal attestation". Show projected token usage and estimated cost.

Sara Gomez: Rollout plan:
1) Feature flag behind `audit.unmask.v1`
2) Internal beta for platform+legal (1 week)
3) Canary on staging with `acme-corp-test` tenant
4) Gradual rollout + quota safeguards (auto-throttle at 80% of tenant reserved capacity)

Alex Wright: Implementation notes:
- route copies via streaming mirror to `audit-ingest` topic
- mirror pipeline applies KMS tag and TTL metadata
- only store raw text in `audit-bucket` for sessions with `approver_id` present
- metric to calc additional billing: `unmask_sessions_total` and `audit_ingest_billed_tokens`

Kevin Patel: Danger: we must ensure that backups, logs, and debug exports don't accidentally include unredacted blobs. Add a telemetry-level flag `hide_unmasked_in_standard_logs:true` and require `audit_viewer` role to see them.

Maria Chen: Legal asked for immutable audit entries. Can we append write-only records (no purge) for the audit log but allow retention-based deletion for the raw payloads? Legal wants deletions to be auditable.

privacy-bot: We can keep an append-only ledger entry (hash of payload + KMS ref) and record deletion events with signer identity. Raw payload delete should leave ledger row showing deletion_ts and reason.

Jordan Lee: Quick checklist for security review:
- KMS integration verified
- RBAC for `audit_viewer` + `audit_admin`
- Console confirmation + 2FA for enable
- Quota guardrails and billing alerts

Sara Gomez: Ops: need a dashboard tile `Active Unmask Sessions` and alert if `audit_ingest_billed_tokens` increases >10%/hr. Also a billing projection when starting session.

Alex Wright: UI wire: show projected tokens in modal, plus a required `legal_case_id` free-text and `expected_size` dropdown.

Maria Chen: Ok next steps: Alex + Jordan to spec console changes + API. Kevin + Sara to add quota guardrails + canary plan. Privacy will draft policy language. I'll sync with Legal on attestation format.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: audit-unmask PoC -> staging at 2024-05-10T22:30:00Z :rocket:

Kevin Patel: Thanks. Can we add a small test case in the samples repo to simulate a 1hr unmask session and assert telemetry metrics increment?

Alex Wright: Will add test + a postmortem playbook in case of accidental exposure.

Maria Chen: Great. Tagging followups: @Jordan @Kevin @Sara @privacy-bot. Ping me when you have drafts. :thumbsup:
